text: これから　もっともっと　パワーアップ　されるぞーっ！

structure.jp: これから　もっともっと
structure.en: from now on, more and more

structure.jp: パワーアップ　されるぞーっ！

patterns.name: 〜られる (honorific)
patterns.span: パワーアップ　される
patterns.explanation: The same ending that usually means something is done to you can also just make a verb sound grand and respectful; here the speaker comically uses it about himself. パワーアップ　される = 'will be powering up'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful way of announcing something, and here it is stretched out into a shout. されるぞーっ = 'I will, I tell you!'
